lurp : Roslyn-native semantic context engine for C#

USAGE
  lurp --mode=<mode> --output-dir=<path> [options]

  --output-dir=<path>  Directory where index.db is stored. --solution= may
                       stand in for it when it points at a solution directory.
                       (LURP_OUTPUT_DIR / LURP_SOLUTION_PATH set these too.)

MODES
  --mode=index               Index a solution and store facts in the database.
  --mode=get-source          Retrieve source text for a document by relative path (--document=).
  --mode=get-symbol          Look up symbol metadata.
  --mode=search              Full-text search over source and symbols.
  --mode=find-symbol         Resolve a symbol by FQN.
  --mode=navigate            Resolve an indexed declaration by file and line.
  --mode=diff                Show semantic changes between two snapshots.
  --mode=impact              Trace the impact path of a changed symbol.
  --mode=context             Assemble a context capsule for a symbol.
  --mode=status              Show the current database status.
  --mode=timings             Show step-by-step timing data for a snapshot.
  --mode=annotate            Attach a user-authored annotation to a symbol.
  --mode=get-annotations     Retrieve annotations for a symbol.
  --mode=serve               Run an MCP server over the index (stdio).

OPTIONS BY MODE
  (flags below are exactly the ones each mode accepts, from the mode registry)

  --mode=index
    --solution=             Path to the .sln/.slnx to index (--mode=index); for
                            --mode=status, the workspace to compare against the
                            latest snapshot for freshness.
    --strategy=             full | incremental. 'full' reindexes every document
                            from scratch and is the DEFINITION OF CORRECTNESS
                            (use it to recover a known-good index);
                            'incremental' re-indexes only changed documents.
